name: Roma API
description:
The user's own Roma workspace: tasks, notes, projects, typed lists (collections) and automations. A place an AI chat can store work, pick it up again and keep knowledge between conversations.

Every call acts as the signed-in person, on their own workspace. Authenticate with a Roma API key (Settings → Connections) or an OAuth access token as a bearer. The same operations are available over the Model Context Protocol at /mcp; this REST surface exists for tools that speak HTTP rather than MCP (Zapier, Make, n8n, a script).
